claim_under_attack.claim_text: The module's conformal prediction intervals achieve their nominal coverage on held-out data (OpenPoly Tg 0.968, RadonPy eps_r 0.943 at nominal 0.95).
claim_under_attack.closest_matching_openpoly_tg_receipt: amphora-tolerance-robustness/evidence/phase0/kpis/split-conformal-prediction-openpoly-tg-kpi.v1.json (empirical_coverage_95_pi=0.9683, frozen Push-20 Van Krevelen Ridge base predictor, 50/50 split)
claim_under_attack.closest_matching_radonpy_eps_r_receipt: amphora-molecule-property/evidence/phase0/kpis/mixed-openpoly-radonpy-dielectric-conformal-kpi.v1.json (95% PI coverage=0.9745, RF base predictor, source-stratified 60/20/20 split) -- the literal figure 0.943 was NOT found verbatim in any tolerance-robustness or molecule-property KPI file after exhaustive grep; this is the nearest standing RadonPy-eps_r conformal-coverage artifact and is treated as the claim under test.
claim_under_attack.note_on_base_learner: Part A re-derivation uses the SAME in-pipeline StandardScaler+Ridge(Morgan512+log10MW, seed=0) protocol as the module's own signed jackknife-plus-cvplus / mondrian-conformal / normalized-adaptive / training-conditional-pac audit chain (NOT the frozen Push-20 group-contribution model used by the single headline 0.968 KPI), for direct comparability with that chain. Part B re-derives the RadonPy RF+split-conformal protocol independently from raw PI1070.csv.

falsification_criteria.part_a: REFUTES exchangeability-dependent nominal-coverage claim if scaffold-safe empirical coverage falls below 0.90 (more than 5pp under a rounded floor derived from the module's own training-conditional PAC 5th-percentile bound of 0.9226) OR below random-split coverage by more than 0.05 absolute.
falsification_criteria.part_b: REFUTES the RadonPy eps_r nominal-coverage claim on the admissible subset if the admissible-only empirical coverage's Wilson 95% CI excludes 0.95, or if n_test_admissible is too small (<10) to support any coverage claim at all -- in which case the claim is UNSUPPORTED (indeterminate), not merely low.

part_a_fidelity_replicate_random_split.note: Fidelity gate: this MUST reproduce the module's own signed jackknife-plus-cvplus/mondrian split_conformal marginal coverage exactly (same protocol, same seed) before the scaffold-safe variant below is trusted.

part_a_scaffold_safe_split.method: Bemis-Murcko generic scaffold (RDKit MurckoScaffold, Bemis-Murcko 1996 J.Med.Chem 39:2887); scaffolds shuffled (seed=0) and assigned WHOLE to test until |test| matches the random-split test size, so calibration and test sets share NO scaffold.

part_b_admissibility.constraint: eps_static >= eps_infinity = n_measured^2 (Frohlich 1949 Ch.2 / Debye 1929, model-independent thermodynamic inequality)

part_b_conformal.base_predictor: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_depth=10, random_state=0) on Morgan(512,r=2)+log10(MW) -- same family as the module's split-conformal-on-rf-ml-openpoly-tg-kpi.v1.json

verdict.overall_rationale: The pinned claim bundles two coverage numbers (OpenPoly Tg and RadonPy eps_r) into one statement. RadonPy eps_r coverage, when correctly restricted to physically admissible labels, fails its nominal target with a 95% CI that excludes 0.95 -- a decisive refutation of that half of the claim. A bundled claim with a refuted component is refuted as stated, even though the OpenPoly Tg half survived a genuine scaffold-safe exchangeability attack (marginal coverage held; only the already-known conditional/worst-stratum gap persists).
verdict.part_a_detail: Scaffold-disjoint (non-exchangeable) test split: marginal coverage 0.9719 vs random-split 0.9326 (gap +0.0393); worst-stratum (Bemis-Murcko scaffold, n>=5) coverage 0.8750 on scaffold 'C1CCOCC1' (n=8). Marginal coverage claim was NOT broken by this scaffold-safe split (single seed=0 draw); conditional (per-scaffold) undercoverage is confirmed and is CONSISTENT WITH (not new versus) the module's own signed Mondrian receipt (worst tercile 0.857).
verdict.part_b_detail: Blind-to-admissibility test coverage 0.9558 LOOKS nominal, but this is propped up by the 88%-inadmissible majority (inadmissible-subset coverage 0.9921). Restricted to the 52 PHYSICALLY ADMISSIBLE test rows (eps_static>=n^2), empirical coverage COLLAPSES to 0.6923 (Wilson 95% CI [0.5573, 0.8009]), which EXCLUDES the nominal 0.95 target. The RadonPy eps_r conformal coverage claim is REFUTED on the only physically valid subset of the data it is meant to describe.
